name: Granted To Group
description: An Identity Center account assignment is granted to an identity-store group (assignment -> group), when its PrincipalType is GROUP: AccountAssignments[].PrincipalId, normalized to the group's key (identity store id, group id) with the identity store id taken from the instance. A USER assignment has no edge of this type: users are not nodes (ruling 2026-10-01). A reference, not containment; it ends with its source, since the principal id is part of the assignment's key.
